name: v2-probing-no-trigger
review: The commands and configured 1 mm probe travel predict the recorded Z+10, Z-1, Z+1, XY+10/+10 and Z-5 moves. ZProbe.cpp returns to the start after an untriggered G30, then reports and halts on an untriggered G38.2; both messages are required. Independent tick-rounded calculations reproduce the four subsequent move durations exactly and the initial move within 98 ticks (0.048%); the initial difference remains subject to floating-point rounding. Both firmware revisions reproduced the trace and alarms. Physical probing and board timing remain unverified.
